title: Electronic · home digitals
blurb: The piano as furniture with a power lead: console digitals, hybrids with a real action, and player systems that move the keys themselves.

items.d: 2019 · Yamaha — the top Clavinova, with the GrandTouch action and binaural CFX samples.
2016 · Yamaha — a hybrid with a real grand action and no strings.
2021 · Kawai — the hybrid with the Millennium III grand action and a soundboard speaker.
2022 · Kawai — the wooden-key concert artist digital.
2023 · Roland — the flagship home digital with modelled piano and eight speakers.
2019 · Roland — the mid-range home piano with the PHA-50 action.
2023 · Casio — the Celviano console with a wooden-key action.
2015 · Steinway & Sons — the player system fitted to acoustic grands, streaming performances to the keys.
